question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Chief Minister of Kerala, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pinarayi Vijayan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of **November 2022,** the **Chief Minister of Kerala**, India is **Pinarayi Vijayan. **
 
• Pinarayi Vijayan has been the Chief Minister of Kerala since **May 2016**, after the** Left Democratic Front** (LDF) won the state assembly elections.
 
• Vijayan is a member of the **Communist Party of India** (Marxist) and has been associated with the party for more than four decades.
 
• During his tenure as Chief Minister, Vijayan has initiated several welfare schemes and development projects, including the **KIIFB (Kerala Infrastructure Investment Fund Board)** which has been instrumental in funding several infrastructure projects in the state.
 
• Vijayan's government has also been praised for its efforts in managing the COVID-19 pandemic in Kerala, with the state recording one of the** lowest fatality rates** in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Anandiben Patel** is the **Governor of Uttar Pradesh.**

 
 
• She held the position of **Gujarat's first** and, to date, **only female **chief minister.
 
 
 
• **Basavaraj Bommai** is the **Chief Minister of Karnataka**.
 
 
• He represents **Shiggaon** in the Karnataka legislature as a member of the Legislative Assembly, a position he has held since 2008.
 
 
 
• **Mohan Charan Majhi** is the **Chief Minister of Odisha.**
 
 
• **​**He​ represents the **Keonjhar** Assembly constituency in Odisha​.
